HARMAN designs and engineers connected products for automakers, consumers, and enterprises worldwide, including connected car systems, audio and visual products, and enterprise automation solutions. With leading brands like AKG, Harman Kardon, Infinity, JBL, Lexicon, Mark Levinson, and Revel, HARMAN is admired by audiophiles, musicians, and entertainment venues globally. Over 50 million automobiles are equipped with HARMAN audio and connected car systems. Our software services power billions of mobile devices and systems that are connected, integrated, and secure across all platforms. HARMAN has a workforce of approximately 32,000 people across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In March 2017, HARMAN became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics. HARMAN’s mission is to design and deliver smart products, systems, software, and services that connect people wherever they are.
HARMAN Romania Development Center, headquartered in Bucharest since 2017, has around 700 colleagues specializing in hardware and mechanical engineering, BIOS and firmware development, system and software architecture, software engineering, testing, integration and validation, tool support, functional safety, and requirements engineering. Hüttich Consulting GmbH is an independent consultancy specialising in the analysis and processing of environmental data, with a strong focus on satellite-based Earth observation (EO) services, including Copernicus data and other Big Data sources. Based in Germany, the company supports clients across public authorities, research institutions, and private enterprises in leveraging geospatial information for climate adaptation, environmental monitoring, and sustainable development.
With expertise in processing large-scale environmental datasets, Hüttich Consulting enables decision-makers to transform complex data streams into actionable insights. The company develops customised analysis workflows and advises on the integration of satellite data into operational processes. A key area of focus is the development of innovative business models and services that utilise EO data to address environmental challenges and create value for users.
Hüttich Consulting GmbH offers strategic advisory services, hands-on training, and concept development for data-driven solutions, helping organisations to build capacity and unlock the potential of Earth observation technologies. By bridging the gap between data providers and end-users, the company contributes to the wider adoption of satellite data in practical applications for climate resilience, land use management, and environmental risk assessment.

entityDescription:
Biotech PRO ApS was established in Denmark in 2016 with a resource basis covering more than 30 years of professional experience in Bioprocesses covering several technological solutions within thebiomass technology sector, such as biogas plants, biomass liquefaction, a.o. with focus on developing structured, solid, consolidated, robust and economic solutions. 

Biotech PRO’s aim is to address and implement solutions in the fields of next-generation biofuels (fermentation optimization, innovativeconcepts, reactor configurations), bioproducts (new concepts, optimization, customer tailored solutions), biogas solutions (operation, monitoring and optimization), process modelling (predictionmodels within biosystems) and biorefineries (evaluation of concepts, testing, system analysis).

The company has been involved in several projects, among others in EU projects, such as the Fast-track Innovation project, Neosuccess, and in the EU Horizon Cronus. The company has also provided consultancy and design of specific equipment within the bioenergy sector for specific clients and manufacturers. Biotech Pro has extensive expertise in process design, upscaling from lab to pilot to demonstration and to full scale, system analysis and modeling. Biotech Pro was the core contributor to the Anaerobic digestion model “Biomodel”, improving the understanding of AD process inhibition mechnisms, pH balance and dynamic behavior from 1993 and onwards. Experience basis for full scale plant design includes Lemvig, Thorsø and Blaabjerg biogas plants in Denmark as well as numerous other energy plants across the world.

Its science based approach is the fundamental pillar of all the activities we perform. It is based on 4 steps:

- CONTEXT ANALYSIS. It analyses the operations and the entire life cycle starting from one or more products. We analyse the market and the stakeholders to define the factors that can jeopardize the competitiveness of an organisation;
- ANALYSIS OF THE ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCES OF A PRODUCT OR PROCESS. Quantification of the environmental performances via an assessment of all the potential environmental impacts according to the Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodology;
- OPTIMISATION AND IMPROVEMENT.
It provides solutions to reduce resource consumption and environmental impacts. It develops management and optimisation practices to guide the decision-makingprocess;
- CERTIFICATION ANDCOMMUNICATION. It support organisations in certifying their products with low environmental impact. It identifies corporate environmental and social responsibility projects that can enhance the image and reputation of a company.

description:
Xiphera, Ltd, based in Finland, designs and implements proven cryptographic security for embedded systems. Our strong cryptographic expertise and extensive experience in digital system design enable us to help our customers to protect their most valuable assets.
We offer secure and highly optimised cryptographic Intellectual Property (IP) cores, designed directly for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) and Application Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) without software components. Our broad, fully in-house designed, and up-to-date portfolio, including implementations of Post-Quantum Cryptography, enables cost-effective development projects with fast time-to-market – providing peace of mind in a dangerous world.
Current ESA activity is related to Authenticated Boot and Hardware Root-of-Trust.

TÜV SÜD Energietechnik GmbH Baden-Wuerttemberg (TÜV SÜD ET) was founded on 1 April 1997 under the name of “TÜV Energie- und Systemtechnik GmbH Baden-Wuerttemberg”. It was a spinoff from the former “Nuclear Technology and Radiation Protection” Division of TÜV Bayern Hessen Sachsen Südwest e.V. The company changed its name to “TÜV SÜD Energietechnik GmbH Baden-Wuerttemberg” with effect from 1 April 2006. It is a legal entity (LE) of the TÜV SÜD Group. The company provides
- advisory, inspection and certification services in the fields of energy technology, systems engineering and nuclear technology as well as
- radiation-protection services.
It does so primarily within its activities as an independent and impartial company of experts, not subject to professional instructions from third parties, which is consulted by the supervisory authorities of the German state of Baden-Wuerttemberg pursuant to Section 20 of the German Atomic Energy Act.
TÜV SÜD AG undertakes to exercise its shareholder rights in TÜV SÜD Energietechnik GmbH Baden-Wuerttemberg only to the effect that the impartiality, independence and technical authority of TÜV SÜD ET to provide its services without being subject to professional instructions by third parties will be guaranteed at all times and that TÜV SÜD ET will be able to fully meet all its responsibilities.
The main field of activity of TÜV SÜD ET lies in the testing and inspection of nuclear facilities within the context of nuclear licensing and/or supervisory procedures. The experts of the company and/or its predecessor organisation have operated in this area from the earliest times of peaceful use of nuclear energy. They can thus draw on over 50 years of experience, in particular with nuclear power stations in Baden-Wuerttemberg.
Since the German government’s 2011 decision to phase out nuclear energy by 2022, TÜV SÜD ET has stepped up its efforts to use its know-how in contracts located abroad or placed by international companies, e.g. manufacturers of nuclear components. This business line, while still under development at present, is to be expanded further by the development of new products and the establishment of a sales structure.

entityDescription:
The Institute of Human Genetics, Polish Academy of Sciences (IHG PAS) was founded in 1974, and until 2003 operated under the name of the Department of Human Genetics, PAS.
The Institute has the right to confer doctoral degrees (since 2002) and habilitations (since 2010) in the field of medical sciences in the discipline of medical biology and postdoctoral medical sciences in the discipline of medical biology.
The Institute is the leading centre for human genetics research in Poland and a valued partner in scientific cooperation with many institutions in the country and abroad.
The main research areas of the Institute include molecular genetics, cytogenetics, cellular pathology, cancer genetics, and reproductive biology. In recent years, the Institute has also been developing innovative fields such as transgenesis, epigenetics, genomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics. The genetic research conducted at the Institute not only focuses on expanding fundamental knowledge but also finds practical applications in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases through extensive collaboration with medical institutions.

entityDescription: SAWIE is an advanced digital ecosystem tailored for agriculture and environmental monitoring, serving both the UK and global markets. It harnesses the power of AI to deliver predictive analytics, revolutionizing how farmers approach weather forecasting, crop yield predictions, pest and disease prevention, soil health monitoring, and irrigation management. By analyzing a wealth of data from historical climate patterns to real-time satellite imagery, SAWIE's AI algorithms provide farmers with actionable insights, enabling strategic decision-making to enhance productivity and sustainability. entityDescription:
AO Research Institute Davos is a foundation that contributes to high quality applied preclinical research and development (exploratory and translational) focused towards clinical applications/solutions.
- Investigate and improve the performance of surgical procedures, devices, and substances.
- Foster a close relationship with the AO medical community, academic societies, and universities.
- Provide research environment/support for AO clinicians.
All AO Research Institute Davos projects are applied preclinical research or applied preclinical development projects focused towards clinical applications. Definitions (within the applied research):
- Exploratory applied preclinical research is fundamental research, to solve major clinical problems over an extended timeframe (over ten years).
- Translational applied preclinical research aims at developing a clinical applicable result in around five years and builds upon the fundamental applied preclinical research. This research is usually not possible without the previous fundamental applied preclinical research.
